fields.name: HideUi
fields.doc: Whether the rest of the UI should be hidden while the effect is playing.

fields.name: Id
fields.doc: The asset's id — the file stem by default; stores accept it written inline too.

fields.name: Parent
fields.doc: Inherit every field from another asset of this store, then override what this file sets.

CameraKeyframe.name: Id
CameraKeyframe.doc: Which registered CameraKeyframe variant this object is — the codec map's discriminator.

CameraKeyframe.name: Position
CameraKeyframe.doc: The position the camera should have moved to by the end of this keyframe.

CameraKeyframe.name: Duration
CameraKeyframe.doc: The length of time this keyframe should take, in seconds.

CameraKeyframe.name: Easing
CameraKeyframe.doc: The type of camera easing that should be used.

CameraKeyframe.name: Fov
CameraKeyframe.doc: The FOV the camera should have moved to by the end of this keyframe.

CameraKeyframe.name: RelativeToPlayer
CameraKeyframe.doc: Whether the position and rotation should be relative to the player's current view, or global.
